title: GeoAR Field-Test Session Log
description: Canonical per-session localization log. Identical schema for Prototype A (XREAL SDK) and, later, Prototype B (Android XR) so the shared self-learning loop ingests both without rework. One JSON object per session; emitted as JSONL by devices and POSTed to the shared backend.

device_profile.description: Which prototype generation produced this session.

gps_accuracy_m.description: Raw reported GPS accuracy radius in metres at coarse lock (or best during session).

visual_confidence.description: Best visual recognition confidence score achieved during the session.

time_to_lock_s.description: Seconds from session start (coarse GPS) to fine lock, or to terminal fallback state if never locked.

drift_m.description: Measured anchor drift over the session in metres (max observed).

time_of_day_local.description: HH:MM local time at session start.

final_state.description: Terminal state of the fusion state machine for this session.

outcome.description: success = content rendered aligned within tolerance; degraded = rendered via fallback; failure = no usable render.

source.description: Provenance. NEVER present synthetic/replay entries as field data in any UI.
